title: Resume pre-release documentation alignment on current evidence
outOfScope: Editing the three Trust Layer documents, Capability Truth Matrix, Japanese assessment, README, or security/release guides unless a fresh audit proves a concrete mismatch and the Contract is amended first.
Release publication, tag creation, provider-release mutation, Dependabot changes, final execution-plan cleanup, and local or remote worktree/branch deletion.
Rewriting immutable archived Work Item evidence or adopting uncommitted files from the paused historical documentation-alignment worktree.

sources.reason: The user-authorized serial plan requires final documentation alignment after Japanese remediation and before release.
The prior independent corrective defines the eight document-truth findings whose current-state closure must be re-evidenced.
The last source-bound Japanese reassessment is a release prerequisite whose byte-binding and non-claims must remain truthful.
Defines authoritative documentation roles and reader routes.
The sole current implementation-status authority; documentation alignment must not infer unimplemented capability.
Authoritative Why/What/How boundary that the audit must preserve across language routes.

rawUserRequest: Continue the approved plan without stopping. Before release, documentation must be aligned after Japanese remediation; every Work Item must keep instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability and use a complete PR/CI/merge/closure lifecycle. Use focused local verification under the temporary authorization, without changing permanent governance rules.

riskAssessment.reason: A false green alignment result could permit release-facing documentation to overstate capability, hide a stale source binding, or diverge across language routes. The audit must be source-bound and fail closed on missing evidence.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized continuous planned execution. The Work Item is bounded to deterministic documentation evidence; a newly discovered factual mismatch will be recorded and corrected only within the declared scope or by a successor.

preReviewWarnings: No report may treat structural marker checks as semantic or human-translation proof.
Capability Truth Matrix remains the current-status authority; Trust Layer remains the Why/What/How authority.
The Japanese final assessment must be treated as stale if any source-bound byte changes.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record the current evidence inventory before edits and the final cross-document evidence map before finish.

acceptance: A1: A deterministic, source-bound inventory evaluates the English, Chinese, and Japanese reader entries; Trust Layer; architecture; Capability Truth; security/release verification; Japanese assessment; and current serial plan, with an exact change or no-change reason for every surface.

A2: The audit rejects missing surfaces, duplicate surfaces, missing rationale, unsupported authority assignments, stale plan-stage claims, and a claimed green result without all required review dimensions.

A3: The generated Markdown report is derived from machine-readable evidence and explicitly preserves limitations: it does not prove native-human translation quality, provider identity, runtime isolation, immutable external audit, enterprise compliance, or publication.

A4: The final evidence preserves the authority split: Trust Layer is Why/What/How; Design Philosophy is North Star; Architecture is components/data flow; Security and Release Verification is external-evidence guidance; Capability Truth Matrix is the sole current implementation-status authority.

A5: Focused tests and documentation checks plus all governance gates pass. Local full quality/full pytest are not run solely under the temporary user authorization; the dedicated PR must obtain fresh hosted CI.

A6: The active Outcome is reported directly in Chinese before archive. Then archive, dedicated PR, hosted CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, exact branch cleanup, and synchronized main complete before later release work.
guidelines: Treat every audit conclusion as evidence-bound; use no self-declared completion or capability claim.
Preserve multilingual semantic equivalence and the existing Japanese source-binding boundary; do not silently edit bound sources.
Keep historical archives immutable and clearly distinguish historical plans from current execution instructions.
Do not make the temporary focused-local-verification authorization a permanent repository rule.

intent.problem: The previous pre-release documentation-alignment Work Item stopped on an obsolete base after identifying eight factual and process findings. Independent corrective Work Items and Japanese reassessment followed, but no source-bound, current-main document-alignment proof has closed the stage. Treating the old paused worktree or a historical plan marker as current evidence would risk release on stale or overclaimed documentation.
constraints: Start only from current origin/main and do not adopt the paused worktree's uncommitted changes.
Preserve the authority boundaries and no-overclaim statements across English, Chinese, and Japanese routes.
Use focused local checks under the user's temporary verification direction, without changing governance rule files.
If a required correction changes a Japanese-assessment-bound source, record the issue and follow the required fresh-assessment path rather than silently declaring the old assessment current.
intent.rationale: A current, reviewable evidence map makes documentation alignment a release gate based on repository facts rather than a stale prior assertion.

declaredIntent.summary: Re-establish a current, source-bound documentation-alignment gate after historical corrective Work Items, without claiming human-translation or external-platform guarantees.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: All required documentation surfaces preserve their assigned authority, cross-language routes, no-overclaim boundaries, and current plan state.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The generated machine record and derived report are green only with every required review dimension and a no-change or changed-path rationale for each surface.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused checker and its tests against the current repository state, then record execution evidence in the Summary.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A required surface, rationale, authority assignment, review dimension, source binding, or plan-state assertion is missing or contradictory.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The checker fails closed and names the exact missing or contradictory evidence; the report cannot claim alignment.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add focused red/green tests for representative missing and stale cases before completing the checker.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A current audit finds a factual mismatch in a Japanese-assessment-bound source or a capability-status assertion.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The mismatch is logged, no false completion is reported, and a separately scoped corrective/reassessment path is named when required.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare all source-bound documents and Capability Truth evidence; preserve any finding in the generated record and Summary.

verification.reason: Temporary user authorization for this plan excludes repeated local full quality/full pytest for non-release Work Items; focused checks and all governance gates remain mandatory, and fresh hosted PR CI remains required.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized continuous planned Work Item execution, PR lifecycle, and temporary focused local verification; no protected archive or release path is writable in this scope.

rollbackNote: Revert only this dedicated Work Item's report, checker, tests, and current-plan evidence changes. Do not rewrite historical archives or restore the obsolete paused worktree as current state; record a corrective Work Item for any later factual correction.
